# Siddharth Salunke — Portfolio

> Principal Quality Engineer with 13+ years at Emirates, Qantas and Canva. Test automation, performance engineering, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD.

Static portfolio site (HTML, CSS, vanilla JS — no framework), deployed on AWS S3 + CloudFront.

## Pages

- [Home](https://portfolio.sidsalunke.info/): Profile, work experience, education, and technical skills.
- [AI Engineering](https://portfolio.sidsalunke.info/ai-engineering.html): How Claude Code and other AI tools are used in daily engineering work, plus tools built with them.
- [Quality Suite](https://portfolio.sidsalunke.info/testing.html): The test automation, accessibility, security, and performance-testing practices used to build and verify this site.
